setupLifecycle.policy: Manual registry state wins. Rule logic only stores lifecycleCandidate and may supply lifecycle when no manual state exists. Every rule candidate requires chart review before being treated as confirmed.

dailyDefinition.relativeStrengthShort: 50% 1D + 50% 5D benchmark-relative return, then percentile-ranked across rank-eligible themes
dailyDefinition.participation: share of members with positive 1D return and RVOL >= 1.0
dailyDefinition.concentrationQuality: normalized inverse HHI of positive 5D benchmark-relative returns; single-winner themes score 0
